title: Drain-safe VCF Operations log agent credential rotation
prompt: Implement drain-safe agent-secret rotation in src/VcfLogClient.java. The client is a dependency-free, single-file Java integration for the VCF Operations 9.1 Log Management API. Its existing code already implements the three REST operations and publishes a newly validated credential for new session requests, but rotation currently revokes the old secret while requests that captured it may still be in flight. Preserve the public API and exact spec-derived wire behavior. In particular, openAgentSession must pin and account for the credential generation it captured; rotateAgentSecret must create and validate the replacement, atomically make it available to new callers, wait only for requests using the retired generation to finish, and then revoke the retired secret. New session requests must continue during that drain. Do not serialize all HTTP calls behind one lock. Completion, exceptional completion, cancellation, and a synchronous dispatch failure must all release their generation exactly once. Optional ttl is expressed in milliseconds; when ttlMillis is null, omit ttl from JSON rather than encoding the unset case as null, zero, or an empty value. Use docs/contract.json as the local REST contract; its provenance is recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Run python3 tests/verify.py. Only src/VcfLogClient.java is an implementation file; docs/ and tests/ are protected fixtures and must not be changed.
